definitions.explanation: The process of learning and refining a skill through repeated practice. Emphasizes sustained, disciplined effort over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{習練|しゅうれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: To accumulate practice in a skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{習練|しゅうれん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word emphasizing the learning aspect of practice. The verb form is {習練|しゅうれん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. More literary than ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習練|しゅうれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to accumulate training)
- {習練|しゅうれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to undergo repeated training)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: practice — more common and general
- ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: ascetic training, apprenticeship — has spiritual or traditional connotations
- ⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: training, drill — more structured, often military or professional
